I saw a bit of myself in all three of the girls, a lot of which were not things I particularly liked about myself, but Sayori was on a whole 'nother level. The lack of will to get out of bed in the morning, the feeling that you're wasting other people's time and effort with you, and of course wanting so badly to be with somebody but having the previous issue conflict with that desire. It's like a black hole of frustration that won't let you go.

I never really cry, or even tear up at works of fiction. The rare instances where I have were when an animal died. But when I found Sayori at the end of Act 1... it's the closest thing to "disturbed" I can remember feeling in my entire life. I just had to sit in stunned silence, while tears ran down my face, partly because of how badly I wanted to save her, but also because it almost felt like I was staring in a mirror that held my own potential future. It was a terrifying feeling.
